comment: zitadel/oidc adds a client_id claim to every ID token (equal to azp/aud); harmless, not configurable without forking the library.

The directory has a display name, username and update time; it has no given/family/middle name, nickname, picture, gender, birthdate, zoneinfo or locale yet (profile fields arrive with M1). OIDC Core allows omitting unavailable claims.
The claims request parameter is optional and not supported; name is returned for the profile scope.
No authentication context classes are defined, so no acr claim is issued (acr_values is a voluntary request).
